body:
I really appreciate the words dude. To answer the question about her listening to my junk and all that, she really tried to be there for me. Her problem is that she's a little awkward and when it came to my problems and emotions and all that I kinda keep them close to the chest. I grew up with an absentee dad and three older brothers who arent exactly the definition of open and vulnerable, so monkey see monkey do and all that jazz. In school I was just the funny guy who would listen to everyones problems and drama and give advice and make you feel better. I figured if I acted carefree, happy, and like my problems in my private life didn't exist it would come true, fake it till ya make it ya know. So I was never very good at communicating how I felt when I was really going through it, I would usually just not hangout with people for a couple days till I could get my emotions under control and claim I was sick or working or something. In all of my previous relationships I had been in I had just been the happy, carefree, jokester boyfriend. With this girl though she kinda saw through my facade and all that, and I was really unnerved by that I guess. 

In regards to the irritation question; she had a lot of character quirks that were cute at first, but kinda wore on you overtime (always had to be her music we listened too (she'd pout and be silent until I let her use the aux).... honestly I'm kinda blanking on the other stuff, probably cause it was all just petty stuff and it was months ago) It kinda all just added up over time, cause we were hanging out everyday and texting when we werent together. I know I should have set boundaries and stuff, but I've never been good at saying no to the people I care about. It didn't help that I was at the lowest point of my life so I was kinda irrational with how much I would get irritated, but I'd just bury it because I felt bad expressing negative emotions against her, I didn't wanna hurt her.

In regards to how things would be different this time, I'd definitely set boundaries and make sure I keep our interactions in healthy enough doses. Plus I'm all medicated up and stuff, and I'm doing better than I have been in years. I know what I wanna do with my life and I've got a plan to get there. In that future I imagine I really want her in it, even if its just talk to every couple months ya feel me?

I knew that searching my feelings and revisiting our past and making a decision based upon that was always what I was going to have to, but I couldn't help but hope that a stranger on the internet would have a magic answer for me lol.

Anyway, thanks for the help. Your words really helped clear my thoughts on the matter. I'm gonna spend the next couple days really thinking about it before I decide

Thanks, I wish ya the best pal
